I farm only 1.5 mu, so I will keep things simple and stable this year. I grow maize, and with my age, small land size, and many years of experience, I will choose a way that is reliable and not too labor-demanding. Because some family members work off-farm, I cannot depend on a lot of extra labor at key times, so I will use hybrid seed for better stand and yield. I have well irrigation, so I will not rely only on rainfall. I will use moderate fertilizer, not too little because I still want a good harvest, and not too much because my land is small and I do not want waste. I will do rotary tillage because it is practical and easier for me to manage on a small plot. I will plan a few irrigations and a few pesticide sprays, only as much as needed to keep the maize growing evenly through the season. My goal is a steady maize harvest from one spring planting on the whole 1.5 mu.
